title: Pay for parades and dances
summary: The band got about a dollar and a half for a parade and dance, later raised.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: How much did they get paid in those days for a parade?
When I first started paying, we used to get, we'd average around a dollar and a half for a parade and the dance.
We worked that up to five dollars a month. I remember when we used to play dates in some hall, you know. stuff
